services.name: Gansett Cruises
services.desc: Gansett Cruises - Narrated Harbor Tours & Sunset Cruises in Newport, RI Experience the charm of Newport from the water with Gansett Cruises, offering 60-75 minute narrated harbor tours and sunset cruises aboard the classic 1960s M/V Gansett. Departing from 2 Bowen’s Landing, these cruises provide a unique perspective of Newport’s historic waterfront, grand estates, and iconic landmarks. Discover Newport’s Scenic Beauty Gansett Cruises offers a variety of tours to suit every interest: Morning Mimosa Cruise: Start your day with a refreshing mimosa as you enjoy the morning breeze and scenic views. services.name: Island Style Parasail
services.desc: Island Style Parasail is Newport’s exclusive parasail company and we love what we do. We get the pleasure of giving our guests a birds-eye view of Newport and all it has to offer from the beautiful marina to the 1,154 foot Newport Bridge. We help make memories that last a lifetime. Let Island Style Parasail be part of your Newport experience! We also offer quality gifts and souvenirs. Plus, specialty Bowen’s Wharf merchandise to commemorate your time spent with us! Come visit us in person at 45 America’s Cup Ave on the corner of Market Square so we can share insider info on the best dining, shopping and offer tickets/schedules for tours: America’s Cup Charters Newport Helicopter Tours
